newsitem.title: UK: Higher French market supports UK grain futures.
newsitem.headline: Higher French market supports UK grain futures.

text.p: Higher French wheat prices on Friday following the granting of wheat export subsidies at Thursday's weekly EU tender underpined a thin UK grain futures market.
Wheat closed with gains of 0.25 to 0.95 stg a tonne after trading 373 lots.
Barley futures finished 0.75 stg up on a turnover of 85 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat contact was again neglected.
Higher futures prices were good news for the UK cash market where business was very slow.
"Higher futures always frighten the buyers away," said a trader.
On the fob market November feed wheat traded at 109.25 and Jan/Mar at 112 stg a tonne fob east coast ports.
Trading on the delivered market was mainly for nearby material but tonnages sold were small.
